gaps.sentence: I must get my passport ___ (renew) before the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Get + object + past participle': the passport is renewed by an authority, not by me.

gaps.sentence: The stage was still wet — the scenery ___ (paint) only hours before.
gaps.explanation: 'Only hours before' points to the past perfect passive: had been + painted.

gaps.sentence: She hates ___ (interrupt) when she's deep in work.
gaps.explanation: Passive gerund: being + past participle, after verbs like hate, like, avoid.

gaps.sentence: Passengers ___ (ask) to fasten their seatbelts before take-off.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: are + asked. The agent (crew) is obvious and omitted.

gaps.sentence: The refugees ___ (provide) with blankets and hot meals last night.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + provided. Note the pattern provide somebody WITH something.

gaps.sentence: Your name ___ (find) anywhere on the guest list, I'm afraid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive of ability/possibility: cannot be + past participle.
The policy receives the action: 'will be introduced'.

gaps.sentence: The escaped prisoner ___ (believe) to be hiding in the mountains.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal passive pattern: subject + is believed/said/reported + to-infinitive.
